transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?

I'm just really struggling with how my face looks, especially with this awful acne and scarring all over my skin. It looks absolutely terrible to me, even though everyone else tells me they can barely see anything. I feel so self-conscious about it all the time.

latest_inference.note: The patient's primary concern is a distressing preoccupation with perceived flaws in facial appearance (acne and scarring), which are not observable or appear minor to others. This is a hallmark feature of Body Dysmorphic Disorder. No other diagnoses from the allowed list better account for this specific symptom pattern. The absence of symptoms suggesting psychosis, mood episodes, anxiety unrelated to appearance, trauma, or eating behaviors makes other conditions unlikely at this time.
